title: Dark-Funnel Capture
equation: Dark-Funnel Capture = (Self-Reported + Direct + Branded Search + Mentions) ÷ 4
hook: A lot of your best customers found you through a friend's text that your analytics will never see.
statement: A big chunk of what drives your growth never shows up in your tracking.
explainer: DMs, word of mouth, a podcast mention. None of that gets tagged. If you only invest in what's trackable, you starve the channels that actually bring people in.
sop: Add an open text 'How did you hear about us' field at checkout.
Track searches for your business name month over month.
Score Self-Reported, Direct, Branded Search, and Mentions as shares of your signals.
Message your last 10 customers and ask how they really found you.
Put a small budget behind whatever keeps coming up.
equation_example: Self-Reported 40%, Direct 25%, Branded Search 20%, Mentions 15%. (40 + 25 + 20 + 15) ÷ 4 = 25%. Higher means a lot of your growth is happening off the dashboard. Lower means your tracking is catching most of it.
question: Message your last three customers today and ask exactly how they found you.
closing_statement: Not everything that matters shows up in a dashboard.
caption:
Principle Nº 97: Dark-Funnel Capture

A lot of your best customers found you through a friend's text that your analytics will never see.

A big chunk of what drives your growth never shows up in your tracking.

Your turn: Message your last three customers today and ask exactly how they found you.
